name: ITPI Rate by Hazard Class
description: Publisher-side (Antipodean) ITPI rating table, loaded by P22 from verticals/antipodean/reference/. Held as records rather than inlined in the engine flow so a rate change is an edit, not a deploy. 21 of the sheet's 100 classes carry a rate; the other 79 read 'Not in use' and are not loaded. Class 99 carries 1.0 for both sections, which is a sentinel rather than a rate — no occupation in Rates.csv is assigned it. Classes 1-20 are exactly linear (rate_pi = 0.00473 x (class + 1)) and rate_pl is exactly 1.5% of rate_pi, but they are stored as supplied rather than computed: the sheet is the authority and it may stop being linear.
